output.answer: Mailchimp's main competitors are the other email-marketing and marketing-automation platforms. The three closest challengers by adoption are Brevo, HubSpot and Klaviyo: among more than 700,000 email-sending companies analyzed in late 2026, Mailchimp led with 44.8% penetration, followed by Brevo (18.3%), HubSpot (16.3%) and Klaviyo (13.9%), with MailerLite (5.1%) and Constant Contact (4.4%) in a distant second tier. Roundups of the best Mailchimp alternatives also consistently name ActiveCampaign (advanced automation), GetResponse, Omnisend (e-commerce), Kit, SendGrid (transactional email), Flodesk and Moosend. Klaviyo is the strongest rival in e-commerce email, while HubSpot competes in the all-in-one CRM/marketing space and Brevo — the fastest-growing tool — dominates in France and Germany.
caveats: The penetration figures measure how many companies list a tool in their SPF records (penetration, not exclusive market share), so shares sum to more than 100%; many companies use more than one provider.

Alternative/competitor lists are editorial rankings (Zapier, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse blogs) and each vendor's own list favors itself; the specific ordering of 'main' competitors varies by use case (e-commerce, B2B, newsletters).
Mailchimp remains the market leader by penetration (44.8%), so 'main competitors' reflects the chasing pack rather than tools ahead of Mailchimp.

passages.quote: At 44.8% penetration, Mailchimp appears in more SPF records than the second and third place tools combined... Brevo takes the runner-up spot at 18.3%, ahead of HubSpot (16.3%). Right behind HubSpot sits Klaviyo at 13.9%
passages.source_url: The real surprise is who is in second. [Brevo](https://bloomberry.com/data/brevo/) takes the runner-up spot at 18.3%, ahead of [HubSpot](https://bloomberry.com/data/hubspot/) (16.3%). Right behind HubSpot sits [Klaviyo](https://bloomberry.com/data/klaviyo/) at 13.9%, which is remarkable for a platform that is used mostly by ecommerce companies.

passages.quote: MailerLite (5.1%) and Constant Contact (4.4%) form a distant second tier, and every remaining tool we tracked lands under 2.5%.
passages.source_url: After those four, the floor drops out considerably. [MailerLite](https://bloomberry.com/data/mailerlite/) (5.1%) and [Constant Contact](https://bloomberry.com/data/constant-contact/) (4.4%) form a distant second tier, and every remaining tool we tracked lands under 2.5%. Though this space is littered with many tools, the reality is that the market is dominated by four tools and a very long tail.

key_facts.fact: Mailchimp is used by 44.8% of email-sending companies, more than the next two competitors combined, per a 2026 analysis of 703,516 companies' SPF records.
Brevo is Mailchimp's closest competitor by adoption at 18.3% penetration, followed by HubSpot (16.3%) and Klaviyo (13.9%).
MailerLite (5.1%) and Constant Contact (4.4%) form a second tier, with every other tool under 2.5% penetration.
Zapier's 2026 roundup of the 10 best Mailchimp alternatives names ActiveCampaign, Kit, Constant Contact, HubSpot, Klaviyo, SendGrid, Flodesk, Audienceful, Brevo and MailerLite.

Brevo is the fastest-growing marketing-automation tool and dominates France (67.0% vs Mailchimp's 21.0%) and Germany (37.6% vs 28.8%); Klaviyo is the e-commerce specialist; RD Station leads in Brazil.
